mapper.select: SELECT * FROM planned_occurrence ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO planned_occurrence (source_key, due_date, title, plan_type, plan_id, account_id, target_account_id, card_id, loan_id, attribution, amount, category_id, state, actual_date, actual_amount, entry_id) VALUES (#{sourceKey}, #{dueDate}, #{title}, #{planType}, #{planId}, #{accountId}, #{targetAccountId}, #{cardId}, #{loanId}, #{attribution}, #{amount}, #{categoryId}, #{state}, #{actualDate}, #{actualAmount}, #{entryId})
mapper.update: UPDATE planned_occurrence SET source_key=#{sourceKey}, due_date=#{dueDate}, title=#{title}, plan_type=#{planType}, plan_id=#{planId}, account_id=#{accountId}, target_account_id=#{targetAccountId}, card_id=#{cardId}, loan_id=#{loanId}, attribution=#{attribution}, amount=#{amount}, category_id=#{categoryId}, state=#{state}, actual_date=#{actualDate}, actual_amount=#{actualAmount}, entry_id=#{entryId}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
